title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Extension-Fee Fee-Count Rate
content:
Reservations and Loyalty desk rule note on the extension-fee fee-count rate for Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers.

**Rule.** The extension-fee fee-count rate counts the service-fee entries booked on the credit in the last 12 calendar months. It is **0.60** for at least 2 such entries, **0.80** for exactly one, and **1** for none.

**Window.** An extension-fee window of the last so many calendar months holds the entries dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date the extension fee is worked out, so it rolls back from that date and is not a count of completed calendar months.

**What counts.** Service-fee entries booked on this credit: extension, reinstatement and telephone redemption fee entries dated inside the window.

## Count and rate

| Service-fee entries on the credit in the last 12 calendar months | Fee-count rate |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.60 |
| exactly 1 | 0.80 |
| none | 1 |

## Hypothetical credit (extension fee worked out on 1 July 2026)

The credit carries a telephone fee entry dated 14 June 2026 and a reinstatement fee entry dated 1 July 2025. The reinstatement fee entry is 12 whole calendar months back and falls outside the window. One entry counts, so the rate is 0.80. Had the reinstatement fee entry been dated 2 July 2025, it would be 11 whole calendar months back, both entries would count, and the rate would be 0.60.
